prompt: Prime-time adult animated sitcom characters with simple rounded cartoon bodies, flat colour and black outlines, but every face is painted with startling real skin: pores, stubble, wrinkles, wet tired eyes, real eyelids, far more lifelike than anything around it, no feature exaggerated. Every colour is laid on in thick visible oil brushstrokes. Night, close on a tall skinny mayor in a bowler hat with a heavy gold mayoral chain round his neck, a long narrow face, hollow cheeks and a pencil-thin grey moustache backed against the hot iron door of a furnace, his real-skinned face large in frame, sweating, eyes darting, a desperate smile, holding up a tall white tiered cake on a silver tray that trembles in his hands. The orange furnace glow behind his head; the dark shapes of a crowd's shoulders at the edges of the frame. Most of the frame in shadow; the brightest values are the white cake and the furnace glow. Plain margins with no writing. Thanks.
